Container.Name: unraid-taskline
Container.Overview: Read-only task discovery for Unraid. Lists Docker containers, scans Radarr scheduled tasks via its API, and combines results with host cron and User Scripts. Combines cron forecasts and recurring Radarr task projections in a weekly timetable. Other application adapters are not yet available. Docker socket access grants Docker daemon privileges even with a read-only mount; an endpoint-filtered proxy is recommended. Use only on a trusted LAN.
Container.Requires: Radarr requires a reachable URL and API key. Host paths must exist.

Config.Name: Configuration and Scan Results
Config.Description: Persistent scan snapshots and optional integrations.json credentials.

Config.Name: User Scripts
Config.Description: Optional. Only mount if the User Scripts plugin is installed.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Optional when using a proxy. Socket access grants daemon privileges despite ro. App only requests GET /containers/json?all=1.

Config.Name: Docker Endpoint
Config.Description: Unix socket or HTTP(S) endpoint-filtered proxy; only GET /containers/json is needed. Remove the socket mount when using a proxy.

Config.Name: Cron Day Matching
Config.Description: true: POSIX day-of-month OR weekday when both restricted. Set false only for a scheduler that requires both.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Container time zone; timetable uses browser local time.
